summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 2, best_version=2). Six labelled vertices B, A, G, D, C, E were verified visually and by CV binding. Segments: solid B–A and B–E–D, solid A–E, solid E–C, solid C–D, dashed A–G and G–D, solid baseline extensions beyond G and D. The critic scored it 0.93 with no remaining issues after the E-label repair.
